name: HUBO 2
dof_breakdown: neck 3, arms 7 each, hands 5 each, torso 1, legs 6 each
summary: The commercial HUBO — spun out of KAIST's lab robot into Rainbow Robotics and sold to research groups, several of them in the United States, where it became a shared platform for whole-body control work. Its signature is a straight-leg walking gait rather than the permanently bent knees most bipeds of the era used to stay balanced.
notable: Straight-leg walking gait, unusual for its generation
Sold to overseas labs as a shared research platform

sources.title: Hubo 2 — ROBOTS: Your Guide to the World of Robotics
